name: Cloudflare application foundation
description: Establish the Next.js web application, standalone Hono Worker API, shared types, environment validation, tenant context, observability, and local development commands.
steps: Web runs on port 3015
API health endpoint runs independently
Invalid or missing environment fails safely
Requests carry trace IDs and structured errors

name: Authentication and tenant authorization
description: Implement Better Auth on Hono/D1 with email/password, magic links, verified-email identity changes, organization roles, speaker ownership checks, API keys, and strict tenant isolation.
steps: Magic-link login works
Email and password login works
Unauthorized requests return 401
Cross-tenant access is denied
API keys are scoped and revocable

name: Airtable domain repository
description: Model program business entities in Airtable behind typed repositories with stable application IDs, pagination, retries, rate-limit handling, and deterministic test doubles.
steps: All core entities round-trip
Airtable record IDs never become public IDs
Rate limits retry safely
Repository tests use a deterministic fake

name: Event and CFP configuration
description: Allow organizers to configure event details, first-party session/settings surfaces, rooms, tracks, agenda-eligible statuses, CFP dates, submission limits, tags, formats, levels, dynamic form fields/file requests, validation, welcome copy, and helpful links.
steps: Organizer can create and edit an event
Required and optional fields are configurable
Submission limits and dates are enforced
Preview matches the public form

name: Five-step speaker submission
description: Deliver the evidence-matched Welcome, Account, Submission, Participant, and Review flow with rich text, drafts, searchable selects, co-speakers, secondary contacts, validation, and confirmation.
steps: Progress is preserved across steps
Drafts resume without data loss
Required validation is accessible
Participants can be added and edited
Review can navigate back to edit
Submission emits one confirmation

name: Speaker portal and tasks
description: Provide speaker home, submissions, profile, status, and task views; allow biography updates and post-acceptance task completion with private file uploads.
steps: Speaker sees only owned records
Status changes are visible
Biography can be updated
Accepted speakers receive tasks
Private uploads require authorized expiring access

name: Committee review and decisions
description: Author versioned evaluation plans, rounds, assignments, visibility projections, rubrics, comments, conflicts, and blind review; collect reproducible scores and record human-authoritative accept/waitlist/reject decisions with advisory AI suggestions that require human application.
steps: Assignments obey plan rules
Reviewers cannot access unassigned content
Conflicts remove access
Rubric totals are reproducible
Only authorized organizers decide
AI cannot make final decisions

name: Transactional email workflows
description: Send verified-account, confirmation, reminder, task, schedule, and accept/waitlist/reject messages through OpenSend using approved foreverbrowsing.com identities with versioned templates, event-scoped recipient groups, idempotency, retries, delivery history, and auditing.
steps: Correct sender identity is used
Duplicate jobs do not duplicate mail
Failures retry and remain observable
Templates escape unsafe content

name: Conflict-safe agenda scheduling
description: Schedule eligible sessions into configured rooms and tracks with timezone-aware slots, speaker/resource conflict detection, concurrent mutation locks, private draft versions, advisory AI proposals, and explicit human-reviewed publication.
steps: Accepted sessions can be scheduled
Speaker and room overlaps are blocked
Concurrent writes cannot bypass conflicts
Draft changes do not leak publicly
Published versions remain auditable

name: Standards-based calendar delivery
description: Generate RFC 5545 REQUEST, UPDATE, and CANCEL messages for Gmail, Outlook, Apple Calendar, and generic iCal clients with stable UID, incrementing SEQUENCE, and explicit TZID.
steps: Initial publish sends REQUEST
Schedule changes reuse UID and increment SEQUENCE
Removal sends CANCEL
DST and timezone fixtures pass
No calendar-provider OAuth is required

name: Public speaker and agenda embeds
description: Publish responsive, accessible, fast speaker gallery and itinerary/agenda surfaces using only explicitly published projection data.
steps: Unpublished data is never exposed
Embeds work responsively
Keyboard and screen-reader navigation passes
Public responses are cacheable and fast

name: Versioned public API and webhooks
description: Expose documented, tenant-scoped REST resources with cursor pagination, consistent errors, idempotent writes, OpenAPI, scoped API keys, and signed retrying webhooks.
steps: OpenAPI describes every public endpoint
Unauthorized calls return 401
Pagination is stable
Idempotency prevents duplicate writes
Webhook signatures and retries verify

name: Audit, security, and privacy controls
description: Implement audit events, secure rich-text handling, CORS/CSRF protections, rate limiting, secret hygiene, private files, data minimization, and safe error responses.
steps: XSS and injection payloads are harmless
Disallowed origins are rejected
No secrets or stack traces leak
Sensitive mutations are audited
Rate limits protect public and auth routes

name: Cloudflare deployment
description: Provision and deploy Workers, D1, Durable Objects, R2, Queues, and the web surface with reproducible configuration and least-privilege credentials.
steps: Preview and production deployments are reproducible
Migrations apply safely
Secrets are provider-managed
Health and smoke checks pass after deploy

name: Accessibility and performance
description: Meet WCAG 2.1 AA on primary flows and deliver a fast, polished experience that nontechnical event-production professionals can use without code or CLI knowledge.
steps: axe has no critical violations
Primary flows are keyboard operable
Labels and errors are announced
Core pages meet defined Web Vitals and API latency budgets
Organizer workflows use plain language and task-oriented navigation

name: First-party session and event settings
description: Provide tenant-scoped organizer CRUD for events, sessions, rooms, tracks, statuses, and session settings, including the Accepted default agenda eligibility and audited eligibility changes; the agenda catalog must consume these first-party records.
steps: Organizer creates and edits events and sessions without generic resource CRUD
Rooms and tracks are managed in event settings
Accepted is the default agenda-eligible status and eligibility changes are audited
Agenda reads the tenant/event-scoped settings and catalog

name: Dynamic CFP fields and file requests
description: Render organizer-authored published CFP schemas end to end, including built-in/custom fields, sections, conditional questions and routing, validation, and explicit file-request fields for public submissions and first-party editors.
steps: Organizer publishes a schema with custom fields and conditional sections
Public and preview forms render the same dynamic schema
File requests enforce allowed type, size, authorization, and finalization state
Submitted answers retain immutable field/schema versions

name: Participant portal collaboration workspace
description: Expand the authenticated portal with server-derived multi-event switching, draft autosave/resume, pre-close submission editing and audited reopen, explicit co-speaker roster management, session files with version history/comments/authorized downloads, validated form tasks, and published wiki/resources.
steps: Only authorized event contexts appear in the account-menu switcher
Changed CFP answers autosave with visible state and stale-version recovery
Eligible users can edit submissions and manage co-speakers with explicit capabilities
Files expose request type, pending/ready/rejected status, immutable history, comments, and fresh downloads
Form tasks validate server-side responses and support needs-changes/reopen history
Published wiki/resources are event-scoped and stale event data clears on switch

name: Verified participant profile identity
description: Provide a narrow account identity and event profile workflow: reauthenticate and verify a new email/username, preserve grants by stable account ID, prevent duplicate verified identities, and version authorized event display-profile changes.
steps: Account settings separates identity changes from event profile edits
New email verification and failure/pending/completion states are explicit
Changing identity does not silently transfer or remove event grants
Event profile edits remain event-scoped, authorized, and versioned

name: Evaluation authoring, visibility, and versioning
description: Let authorized organizers author evaluation plans, rounds, assignments, rubrics, blind-review settings, evaluator-visible session/speaker fields, and optional uploaded-file projections; lock or version grading configuration so historical scores remain reproducible.
steps: Organizer creates and versions plans, rounds, rubrics, and assignments
Reviewers receive only the selected field/file projection for assigned submissions
Grading configuration locks or versions when a plan opens or receives scores
Historical scores retain the exact plan and rubric revision
Plan results remain organizer/admin-only

name: Outcome and event email communications
description: Project human accept, waitlist, and reject decisions to participant state and deliver them through versioned OpenSend templates; add an event-scoped organizer compose/send workflow with explicit groups, preview, recipient snapshots, idempotency, per-recipient delivery state, and send history, excluding SMS, CRM, and marketing automation.
steps: Accept, waitlist, and reject outcomes update participant-visible status
Decision templates are versioned, rendered safely, and auditable
Organizer previews an event recipient group and template version before sending
Recipient snapshots, idempotency keys, per-recipient delivery, retries, and history are retained
No SMS, contact CRM, or marketing campaign behavior is introduced

name: Program reports and grade exports
description: Provide program-only saved report definitions and runs over allowlisted session, participant/speaker, and evaluation-plan progress data, with filters, relationships, field ordering, sorting, audited CSV/XLSX execution, and reproducible individual/cumulative grade exports for a selected evaluation-plan version.
steps: Organizer saves, names, edits, deletes, and reruns an allowlisted report definition
Definitions enforce event authorization for fields, relationships, filters, and sorting
Runs export spreadsheet-safe CSV or XLSX and audit requester, parameters, time, and output
Grade exports produce individual and cumulative results from a reproducible plan version
Blind-review notes, private files, unauthorized personal data, and CRM entities never enter exports

name: Advisory AI evaluation, agenda, and content assistance
description: Add private, provenance-bearing AI suggestions for evaluation candidates, agenda placement proposals, and program-content remix candidates. Every suggestion remains advisory until a human applies, accepts, edits, or rejects it; deterministic authorization, scoring, conflict, version, publication, export, and communication rules remain authoritative.
steps: Evaluation suggestions carry rubric/submission revisions and cited evidence and never count before human resolution
Agenda runs snapshot criteria, create a private diff, support reject/regenerate/selective apply, and never auto-publish or override hard conflicts
Content remix compares original/candidate session or speaker text, supports bounded guidance and regeneration, and saves only explicit human revisions
Stale or unconfirmed AI output is excluded from scores, rankings, decisions, exports, messages, and public projections
Every AI application records the human actor, source revision, and audit outcome

name: Tenant-reusable versioned fields
description: Allow a tenant to reuse explicitly shared field definitions across its events without platform-global or cross-tenant coupling; expose references and impact before changes and preserve immutable schema/answer versions for existing submissions.
steps: A field is clearly event-local or tenant-reusable
Only the owning tenant can reference or change a reusable definition
Impact and references are visible before a reusable-field change
Existing submissions retain the prior definition and answer schema version
No reusable field mutates data across tenants

name: End-to-end release verification
description: Prove the evaluator walkthrough through automated tests, Ever, and codex-cua interaction checks before changing the Forge repository from private to public.
steps: Checks, unit, API, security, and E2E suites pass
Ever walkthrough passes
codex-cua visual and interaction checks pass
Deployed smoke test passes
Representative nontechnical event operators can complete CFP, review, speaker-task, and agenda workflows without technical assistance
Release walkthrough covers portal switching/files/form tasks, accept/waitlist/reject communications, reports/grade exports, and advisory AI review/agenda/remix with explicit human application
Forge remains private until every gate passes
